extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A comparison of two quantities by division.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit Rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rate associated with a ratio whose denominator is 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent Ratios
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ratios that describe the same multiplicative relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Proportional Relationship
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relationship between quantities with equivalent ratios.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant of Proportionality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The constant unit rate in a proportional relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Rational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that can be written as a ratio of integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Irrational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that is not rational.

extracted_concepts.name: Number Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A line used to represent and order numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Absolute Value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The distance of a number from zero on a number line.

extracted_concepts.name: Greatest Common Factor
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The largest factor shared by two whole numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Least Common Multiple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The smallest multiple shared by two whole numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Standard Algorithm for Division
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A standard step-by-step method for dividing multi-digit numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Operations with Rational Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing rational numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Decimal Representation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rational number written as a decimal using long division.

extracted_concepts.name: Expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mathematical phrase with numbers, variables, and operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Variable
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A letter that stands for a number.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent Expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expressions that have the same value for the same variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A statement that two expressions are equal.

extracted_concepts.name: Inequality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A statement comparing expressions using greater than or less than.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An expression with variables of degree one.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An equation with variables of degree one.

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rule assigning exactly one output to each input.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose graph is a straight line.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The rate of change of a linear function.

extracted_concepts.name: Integer Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponent that is an integer.

extracted_concepts.name: Radical
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A square root or cube root symbol representing solutions.

extracted_concepts.name: Right Triangle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A triangle with one right angle.

extracted_concepts.name: Similar Triangles
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Triangles with proportional side lengths and equal angles.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A theorem relating the side lengths of a right triangle.

extracted_concepts.name: Congruence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Figures having the same size and shape.

extracted_concepts.name: Transformations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rotations, reflections, translations, and dilations of figures.

extracted_concepts.name: Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The measure of a two-dimensional region.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The measure of space inside a three-dimensional figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistical Question
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A question that anticipates variability in data.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of Center
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Summary values such as mean and median.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of Variability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Summary values such as interquartile range and mean absolute deviation.

extracted_concepts.name: Scatter Plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A graph displaying paired bivariate data.

extracted_concepts.name: Random Sampling
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Selecting a sample to draw inferences about a population.

extracted_concepts.name: Probability Model
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A model used to investigate chance processes.

extracted_relations.evidence: Understand the concept of a unit rate associated with a ratio.
Make tables of equivalent ratios.
Proportional relationships extend ratio reasoning.
Identify the constant of proportionality from tables, equations, and graphs.
Compute unit rates associated with ratios of fractions.
Understand positive and negative numbers on a number line.
Understand ordering and absolute value of rational numbers.
Numbers that are not rational are called irrational.
Convert a rational number to a decimal using long division.
Apply and extend understandings to add, subtract, multiply, and divide rational numbers.
Expressions in which letters stand for numbers.
Identify when two expressions are equivalent.
Equations compare expressions.
Write an inequality of the form x > c or x < c.
Linear expressions are expressions.
Linear equations are equations.
Solve multistep linear expressions and equations with rational coefficients.
Interpret the equation y = mx + b as defining a linear function.
A linear function is a type of function.
A function assigns to each input exactly one output.
In y = mx + b, m defines the slope.
Interpret the unit rate as the slope.
Use similar triangles to explain why the slope m is the same.
Work with radicals and integer exponents.
Understand and use the Pythagorean Theorem.
Similar triangles involve proportional side lengths.
Congruent figures are obtained by rotations, reflections, and translations.
A statistical question anticipates variability.
Summarize numerical data sets with measures of center.
Use the equation of a linear model to solve problems with scatter plot data.
